findings.text: non-blocking: _read_review_once re-implements reckon/file_memo.py:439 memoized_key, the repository's owner of a bounded memo against a caller-carried change key (deep copies in and out, LRU eviction); reckon/crew/obligations.py:1667 already memoises select_review_for_head through that owner, so this is a second capability for the same job and it drops the owner's lock and 50,000-entry bound for an unguarded 1024-entry dict. Fold into a follow-up that routes the answer through file_memo.memoized_key.

non-blocking: the eviction pop(next(iter(_READ_REVIEW_ANSWERS))) is a check-then-act across two bytecodes with no lock, so two threads reaching a miss concurrently can select the same first key and the second pop raises KeyError inside a producer tick; file_memo's locked LRU at reckon/file_memo.py:456 does not have this window. Fold into the same follow-up.
